annotations.summary: A question took longer than expected end to end (p95 over 15 minutes).
annotations.description: A question took longer than expected end to end (p95 over 15 minutes). Threshold: {{$threshold}}, value: {{$value}}.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, quantile(0.95)(duration_nano)/1e9 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name LIKE 'invoke_workflow%' AND attributes_string['nexo.operation'] = 'start' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

alert: Nexo: too many model calls per question

annotations.summary: Questions are making more model calls than a healthy investigation needs; the agent may be looping.
annotations.description: Questions are making more model calls than a healthy investigation needs; the agent may be looping. Threshold: {{$threshold}}, value: {{$value}}.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(min_ts, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, avg(calls) AS value FROM (SELECT trace_id, min(timestamp) AS min_ts, countIf(name LIKE 'chat%') AS calls FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} GROUP BY trace_id HAVING countIf(name LIKE 'invoke_workflow%') > 0) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

annotations.summary: More than 5% of Nexo spans ended in an error.
annotations.description: More than 5% of Nexo spans ended in an error. Threshold: {{$threshold}}, value: {{$value}}.

spec.name: A
spec.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, countIf(has_error) / count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE serviceName = 'nexo' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
